class.name: RailVehicleBrake
class.brief_description: Represents and configures the vehicle brake system and exposes controls to operate it.
class.description: RailVehicleBrake provides access to the underlying brake model for a vehicle. It lets you: - Configure key pneumatic parameters (pressures, tank volumes, cylinder geometry, friction method). - Select the brake distributor/valve type used by the vehicle. - Operate the main brake handle and auxiliary features like the brake releaser.

method.name: alarm_chain
method.description: The passengers' alarm chain pulled or let go ([code]AlarmChainSwitch()[/code], [code]Train.cpp:1839-1872[/code]).

method.name: auto_rewident
method.description: Sets the brake delay to [param brake_delay] (a [enum BrakeDelaySetting]), releases the hand brake and the spring brake - what the original's driver does to the cars of a trainset it takes ([code]AutoRewident()[/code], [code]Driver.cpp:2154-2165[/code]).

method.name: brake_level_charging
method.description: The train brake handle held at the filling position while [param active]; let go, a self-returning handle (FVel6, MHZ_EN57, MHZ_K8P) goes back to drive.

method.name: brake_level_decrease
method.description: Moves the main brake handle the player's brake step ([code]controls/brakestep[/code] of [UserSettings]) positions toward release (less braking). Clamped at the minimum position.

method.name: brake_level_increase
method.description: Moves the main brake handle the player's brake step ([code]controls/brakestep[/code] of [UserSettings]) positions toward more braking. Clamped at the maximum position.

method.name: brake_level_set
method.description: Sets the normalized brake handle level in the range 0.0..1.0. 0.0 maps to [constant BRAKE_HANDLE_POSITION_MIN], 1.0 maps to [constant BRAKE_HANDLE_POSITION_MAX]. The mapping is linear between the device-specific minimum and maximum positions. See also [method brake_level_set_position].

method.name: brake_level_set_position
method.description: Places the brake handle at a predefined position: MIN, MAX, DRIVE, FULL, or EMERGENCY.

method.name: brake_operation_mode_decrease
method.description: The previous operation mode the brake has ([code]BrakeOpModeFlag[/code]; [code]OnCommand_trainbrakeoperationmodedecrease[/code], [code]Train.cpp:2445-2478[/code]).

method.name: brake_operation_mode_increase
method.description: The next operation mode the brake has ([code]BrakeOpModeFlag[/code]; [code]OnCommand_trainbrakeoperationmodeincrease[/code], [code]Train.cpp:2445-2478[/code]).

method.name: brake_releaser
method.description: Operates the brake releaser (overrides to quickly release brake cylinder pressure). Pass true to engage the releaser, false to disengage. Typically used momentarily.

method.name: compressor
method.description: Switches the compressor ([code]CompressorSwitch()[/code]); the command is sent along the control line to the vehicles that carry one.

method.name: consist_releaser
method.description: Switches the releaser of this vehicle's valve directly, whatever the cab's conditions - what the original's [code]consistreleaser[/code] does to each vehicle of a trainset ([code]simulation.cpp:184[/code]). Switched on, it stays on until the brakes stop braking.

method.name: ep_brake
method.description: The electro-pneumatic brake applied or released ([code]SwitchEPBrake()[/code], [code]Mover.cpp:4153[/code]); [code]true[/code] when it changed.

method.name: get_air_pressure
method.description: The brake cylinders' pressure [lb]MPa[rb] ([code]BrakePress[/code]).

method.name: get_alarm_chain_pulled
method.description: Whether the alarm chain is pulled ([code]AlarmChainFlag[/code]).

method.name: get_compressor_allowed
method.description: Whether the compressor's switch is on ([code]CompressorAllow[/code]).

method.name: get_compressor_enabled
method.description: Whether the compressor runs ([code]CompressorFlag[/code]).

method.name: get_compressor_pressure
method.description: The main reservoir's pressure [lb]MPa[rb] ([code]Compressor[/code]).

method.name: get_control_pressure
method.description: The control reservoir of the independent brake valve [lb]MPa[rb] ([code]LocHandle->GetCP()[/code]).

method.name: get_control_reservoir_pressure
method.description: The distributor's control reservoir [lb]MPa[rb] ([code]GetCRP()[/code]).

method.name: get_controller_position
method.description: Where the train brake handle stands, in the handle's own units ([code]fBrakeCtrlPos[/code]).

method.name: get_controller_position_normalized
method.description: Where the train brake handle stands, 0 at its minimum and 1 at its maximum ([constant HANDLE_POSITION_MIN], [constant HANDLE_POSITION_MAX]).

method.name: get_feed_pipe_pressure
method.description: The feed (main reservoir) pipe's pressure [lb]MPa[rb] ([code]ScndPipePress[/code]).

method.name: get_force
method.description: The braking force of the vehicle [lb]kN[rb] ([code]Fb[/code]).

method.name: get_force_at
method.description: The force the vehicle's brake would give [lb]N[rb] at [param ratio] of its full pressure and [param velocity] [km/h] ([code]BrakeForceR()[/code], [code]Mover.cpp:4606[/code]) - what a driver works out its braking from ([code]TController::CheckVehicles()[/code], [code]Driver.cpp:2286-2291[/code]).

method.name: get_force_ratio
method.description: How much of its maximum force one brake block is making, 0-1.

method.name: get_handle_control_pressure
method.description: The control reservoir of the driver's brake valve [lb]MPa[rb] ([code]Handle->GetCP()[/code], [code]Train.cpp:8908[/code]).

method.name: get_handle_ep_time_controlled
method.description: Whether the EP brake is applied by how long the handle is held ([code]TDriverHandle::TimeEP[/code]).

method.name: get_handle_position
method.description: Where the named [param position] of the train brake handle stands, in the handle's own units - it depends on the handle's type ([code]TDriverHandle::GetPos()[/code]).

method.name: get_handle_time_controlled
method.description: Whether the handle sets the pipe pressure by how long it is held, not by where it stands ([code]TDriverHandle::Time[/code]).

method.name: get_local_position_normalized
method.description: Where the independent brake handle stands, 0-1 ([code]LocalBrakePosA[/code]).

method.name: get_local_valve_flow
method.description: The flow through the independent brake valve ([code]dpLocalValve[/code]).

method.name: get_loco_pressure
method.description: The independent (locomotive) brake's pressure [lb]MPa[rb] ([code]LocBrakePress[/code]).

method.name: get_main_pipe_locked
method.description: Whether the main pipe is cut off from the brake valve ([code]LockPipe[/code], the [code]i-mainpipelock[/code] lamp, [code]Train.cpp:11758[/code]).

method.name: get_manual_position
method.description: The hand brake's position ([code]ManualBrakePos[/code]).

method.name: get_pipe_brake_pressure
method.description: The pressure the brake pipe brakes the vehicle by [lb]MPa[rb] ([code]PipeBrakePress[/code]).

method.name: get_pipe_pressure
method.description: The brake pipe's pressure [lb]MPa[rb] ([code]PipePress[/code]).

method.name: get_releaser_active
method.description: Whether the distributor's releaser is on ([code]Hamulec->Releaser()[/code]).

method.name: get_tank_volume
method.description: The air in the brake's reservoir ([code]Volume[/code]).

method.name: get_unit_force
method.description: The force of one brake block ([code]UnitBrakeForce[/code]).

method.name: is_braking
method.description: Whether the cylinder is filling ([code]b_on[/code], [code]GetBrakeStatus()[/code], [code]hamulce.h:55-64[/code]).

method.name: is_cut_off
method.description: Whether the brake is cut off from the train brake ([code]b_dmg[/code]).

method.name: is_holding
method.description: Whether the cylinder holds its pressure ([code]b_hld[/code]).

method.name: local_brake_decrease
method.description: The independent brake handle one notch back ([code]DecLocalBrakeLevel()[/code]); nothing where the local brake is the hand wheel ([code]Train.cpp:1724[/code]).

method.name: local_brake_increase
method.description: The independent brake handle one notch on ([code]IncLocalBrakeLevel()[/code]); nothing where the local brake is the hand wheel ([code]Train.cpp:1724[/code]).

method.name: local_brake_set
method.description: The independent brake handle at [param level], 0-1 ([code]LocalBrakePosA[/code]); nothing where the local brake is the hand wheel.

method.name: manual_brake_decrease
method.description: The hand brake one position back ([code]DecManualBrakeLevel()[/code]).

method.name: manual_brake_increase
method.description: The hand brake one position on ([code]IncManualBrakeLevel()[/code]), on a vehicle that has one.

method.name: universal_brake_button
method.description: One of the vehicle's universal brake buttons ([code]UBB1..3[/code] in the FIZ, [param button] 0-based) pressed or let go ([code]UniversalBrakeButton()[/code]).

Supplied directly from the vehicle's high-voltage traction circuit ("mains"). Available whenever the HV circuit is live (for example, pantograph up and main contactors closed). Does not require the auxiliary converter.
Powered from the auxiliary converter (110 V) and switched by hand - what a FIZ without [code]CompressorPower=[/code] has (Mover.cpp:10512).
Powered from the low-voltage auxiliary converter. The compressor becomes available automatically after the converter is switched on and stops when the converter is off.

Coupled with a diesel engine. Starts automatically with the engine, and the delivery depends on engine RPM. When pressure exceeds the governor threshold, excess air is vented instead of stopping the compressor.
Powered via the train's low-voltage train line supplied by another vehicle through coupler side 1 (front). Requires the remote vehicle's converter to be on.
Powered via the train's low-voltage train line supplied by another vehicle through coupler side 2 (rear). Requires the remote vehicle's converter to be on.
